plugin.name: Gun Widescreen Fix
ResX.description: Width in pixels. Zero selects the desktop resolution. Restart required.
ResY.description: Height in pixels. Zero selects the desktop resolution. Restart required.
FixHUD.description: Preserve HUD and text proportions and center their positions on widescreen displays. Restart required.
FixFOV.description: Adjust the native field of view for the display aspect ratio. Restart required.
FOVFactor.description: Multiplies gameplay field of view; larger is wider. Cutscenes, active zoom and unavailable camera state keep their native framing. Applies at once.
SkipIntro.description: Skips the publisher and studio logo videos. The game's intro still plays. Needs a restart.
GameSpeed.description: Native timing value; the shipped default is 30. Lower values increase game speed and higher values decrease it. Zero leaves the native value unchanged. Restart required.
WindowMode.description: Fullscreen, a framed window at the selected resolution, or borderless at the monitor resolution. Changes apply at the next game frame. Alt+Enter returns to the last window mode.
menu.title: Plugins
menu.settingsfilehelp: Shows the settings file in File Explorer
menu.presethelp: Vanilla: as released. Recommended: the defaults. Enhanced: everything turned up.
menu.restoredefaultshelp: Sets the settings of this page to their defaults.
menu.restartwarning: The game must be restarted to apply some settings.
